nodes.description: Storage slot constant holding the proxy admin address (eip1967 admin slot).
Storage slot constant holding the currently active implementation contract address.
Storage slot constant holding the pending/proposed implementation contract address.
Storage slot constant holding the block number from which the next logic may be activated.
Storage slot constant holding the block number before which new proposals are not allowed.
Storage slot constant flag indicating that trust minimisation (lock) has been switched on.
Payable constructor that sets msg.sender as the initial admin.
Internal view helper reading the current logic address from LOGIC_SLOT via assembly sload.
Internal view helper reading the propose block value from PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
Internal view helper reading the next logic activation block from NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
Internal view helper reading the trust minimisation flag from TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
Internal view helper reading the admin address from ADMIN_SLOT.
Internal function writing the admin address into ADMIN_SLOT via assembly sstore.
External admin-gated function that transfers the proxy admin rights.
External admin-gated function that promotes NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT into LOGIC_SLOT once the delay has elapsed.
Payable fallback entry point that forwards to _fallback.
Payable receive entry point that forwards to _fallback.
Internal delegate-forwarding routine that forbids the admin from entering and delegates to _logic().
External admin-gated function that cancels a pending proposal by copying LOGIC_SLOT to NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
External admin-gated function that extends the lock period by writing a later block into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
External admin-gated function that permanently sets the trust-minimised flag.
Internal function computing block.number + 172800 and storing it in NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
Internal function that, after the lock check, stores a new pending logic address and emits the proposal event.
External payable admin-gated function proposing a new logic and delegatecalling arbitrary data into it.
Internal assembly routine performing a raw delegatecall to the current logic with full calldata forwarding.
Caller-controlled address used for the ifAdmin guard, the admin-inequality check and the initial admin assignment.
Arbitrary delegatecall of attacker-influenceable calldata into the newly proposed logic contract.
Raw assembly delegatecall forwarding all calldata/gas to the stored logic address.
Direct assembly sstore writes into the fixed proxy implementation/admin/flag storage slots.
New admin address supplied to changeAdmin.
New propose-block boundary supplied to prolongLock.
New implementation address supplied to proposeToAndCall.
Arbitrary delegatecall payload supplied to proposeToAndCall.
Pending implementation address supplied to _setNextLogic.
Target logic address supplied to _delegate.
Admin address supplied to _setAdmin for storage.
Local temporary holding the pulled NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT value inside upgrade.
Local temporary holding the pulled LOGIC_SLOT value inside cancelUpgrade.
Local temporary holding block.number + 172800 inside _updateBlockSlot.
Local flag capturing the external call success value inside proposeToAndCall.

edges.reason: constructor invokes _setAdmin to initialise admin rights.
constructor forwards msg.sender directly into _setAdmin, making the caller the initial admin.
ifAdmin modifier gates changeAdmin on msg.sender equalling the stored admin.
ifAdmin modifier gates the upgrade function on msg.sender.
ifAdmin modifier gates cancelUpgrade on msg.sender.
ifAdmin modifier gates prolongLock on msg.sender.
ifAdmin modifier gates removeTrust on msg.sender.
ifAdmin modifier gates proposeToAndCall on msg.sender.
_fallback reverts when msg.sender equals the admin address.
_setAdmin writes the new admin into ADMIN_SLOT via assembly sstore.
the newAdm parameter value is persisted into ADMIN_SLOT.
changeAdmin delegates the admin write to _setAdmin.
the caller-supplied new admin is forwarded into _setAdmin.
_admin reads the admin address out of ADMIN_SLOT.
changeAdmin reads the previous admin via _admin for the emitted event.
_logic reads the implementation address from LOGIC_SLOT.
_proposeBlock reads the propose boundary from PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
_nextLogicBlock reads the activation block from NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
_trustMinimized reads the flag from TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
upgrade timing gate require(block.number >= _nextLogicBlock()) creates block-number dependency.
upgrade reads the pending implementation from NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
upgrade writes the pending implementation into LOGIC_SLOT.
upgrade performs a raw assembly sstore on the proxy implementation slot.
_fallback reads _admin to enforce the admin-inequality require.
_fallback reads _logic to obtain the delegatecall target.
_fallback forwards execution to _delegate.
fallback entry point calls the internal _fallback routine.
receive entry point calls the internal _fallback routine.
proposeToAndCall reads _logic to decide the immediate-upgrade branch.
proposeToAndCall reads _trustMinimized to decide the immediate-upgrade branch.
proposeToAndCall calls _updateBlockSlot in the immediate-upgrade branch.
proposeToAndCall writes the new logic into LOGIC_SLOT in the immediate-upgrade branch.
proposeToAndCall calls _setNextLogic in the delayed-proposal branch.
proposeToAndCall performs raw assembly sstore writes to proxy slots.
proposeToAndCall executes an arbitrary delegatecall into the proposed logic.
the caller-supplied newLogic parameter becomes the delegatecall target.
the caller-supplied calldata parameter becomes the delegatecall payload.
newLogic is forwarded into _setNextLogic when trust is minimised.
newLogic is written into LOGIC_SLOT in the immediate-upgrade branch.
newLogic eventually reaches NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT through the proposal path.
block.number + 172800 is computed and stored into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
the nlb local computed in _updateBlockSlot is written into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
_setNextLogic calls _updateBlockSlot to refresh the activation block.
_setNextLogic gates on require(block.number >= _proposeBlock()) via _proposeBlock.
the nl parameter is stored into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT inside _setNextLogic.
cancelUpgrade reads the current logic address from LOGIC_SLOT.
cancelUpgrade writes the current logic address into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
the local logic copy inside cancelUpgrade is stored into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
cancelUpgrade performs raw assembly sstore writes to proxy slots.
prolongLock requires the new value to exceed the current propose block from _proposeBlock.
prolongLock writes the extended lock boundary into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
the b parameter is stored into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
removeTrust writes true into TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
removeTrust performs a raw assembly sstore on the trust flag slot.
_delegate executes the raw assembly delegatecall.
the logic_ parameter becomes the delegatecall target inside _delegate.
the delegatecall executes arbitrary external logic which can re-enter the payable fallback.
the delegatecall in proposeToAndCall runs untrusted logic before the success check, allowing re-entry into proposeToAndCall.
the delegatecall in proposeToAndCall can re-enter the payable fallback proxy entry point.

normalization_plan.reason: the parameter only exists to feed changeAdmin, so it should be folded into that function node.
the lock boundary parameter is only meaningful inside prolongLock and should be merged into it.
the proposed implementation parameter is consumed exclusively by proposeToAndCall and its callees.
the calldata parameter is only the payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation and should be merged there.
the pending logic parameter is only used by _setNextLogic, so it should collapse into that function node.
the logic target parameter exists solely as the delegatecall target of the unsafe operation.
the admin parameter is only consumed by _setAdmin and should be merged into that function node.
the temporary holding the pending logic is local bookkeeping inside upgrade and should be merged into it.
the temporary holding the current logic is local bookkeeping inside cancelUpgrade and should be merged into it.
the computed block temporary is local to _updateBlockSlot and should be merged into that function node.
the call-success flag is local to proposeToAndCall and should be merged into that function node.
